title: Positioning 2026-06-10 (v2): execution-coupled memory verified unoccupied; substrate gets a clock; bench v4 gates the category claim
summary: Full competitive redo (report: /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude/competitive-analysis-2026-06.md; code-level on both sides). Darwin framing holds with two amendments. (1) Moat confirmed at code level: nobody — Graphiti (bi-temporal but ingestion-based, LLM-inferred invalidation, no task entity), Mem0 (deleted OSS graph memory), Letta (identity-scoped), claude-mem/Cognee (observation streams), any Tier-2 orchestrator, or native — produces memory from task completion, invalidates deterministically with provenance, or routes via typed edges under a token budget. (2) Substrate is still a tailwind but now on a 3-18mo subsumption clock (Dreaming beta, CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID, tasks retention sweep); durable core narrows to bi-temporal execution-coupled graph + metric/judge/optimize loop + local-neutral daemon. (3) Open risk sharpened: win-regime ~23% and conjunctive, v5 forced-context net-negative — bench v4 (context-REQUIRED tasks) is the gating proof for "verifiable self-improvement"; wiring context-gate.js into the live daemon path is the second gate. Positioning sentence finalized in report §7; "what was said vs what was done — with receipts" survives as the memory-vendor kill line only. Watch list: Letta Code (Context Repositories), Beads/Gas Town (same fusion thesis, no measurement). Runner-UI layer is a graveyard — position as the intelligence layer feeding fleets.
